## Design

### 2026-10-18 – So I started work on my jigsaw marble run.

**11.67h**

So I started work on my jigsaw marble run.
at first I decided to start my just modeling one part to get the idea so i started with the spiral. I wanted to make sure that it is customizable and that the grid and connections will be simple and easy to implement. Before starting I like to sketch in paint (the app) just to get the mental image started in my head. And then i started CADing it took me more then it should have and I had some problems with the path of the spiral.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 231755](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/8651207a2bd857cf8f4e48ce70dd7012904a80823bc2a4fe65cf19563b15b50d.png)

After the initial design (the image is the last version) I had to do some trouble shooting off camera with the way the 3d sketch handled changes in parameters (took me about an hour, an hour and a half including research) .

Then I went on to make the other 3 pieces that were way way way way more simple.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 231743](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/37c3d0954da5fbea9a112b7c1915b07178c3833fd30f66fdd5693eee57622a1f.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 231803](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/b5d1c8c88e8ecc155ffc8439ffe72a47a420013212e82ab682eb0a195ad62800.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 231817](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/f508c7cc8a896c67bab26a148ae8fb0cbf3dc30667eaa9f4bbd33d3c26ae5579.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 231824](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/2edc2b1395e60215ba864936e6cf3a0d7dd8bf87db41ce70e5181b556a13c474.png)

Also again making sure that the left and right turn are as simple as 2 configurations of the same part (the reason it isn't exactly the same just rotated is because the connections between the marble run parts).

Then came the most fun part making an example marble run, it only took like 5 mins just dragging in the parts and snapping them together using mates.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 231729](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/1a2e723200d24120e48f788acc6a9840d0edfb86cd3837d0fdf4d53438ee9262.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 225512](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/7c1c2846050adb8b3c8dc3de6528338d6372bf1ba30f45cb95d7db7ac6812e29.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 225516](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/29843clWz38nHkXKkSlG9Jv9fbcc3Wsg/10d5e4cee66a9ec4f7471a06bc9d3f00bd33313cfaf287e4cb9cbe9b222cc583.png)

There was one main problem, the configuration publisher. I  had some fights with the SolidWorks configuration publisher while making the models trying to put the customizable dimension on it but i just couldn't because they were global variables. I tested alternatives like linking them using dummy dimensions and more but I just didn't find a solution that satisfied me. After making the prototype i tried solving it for like about 4 hours with no avail. At the end i quit, maybe I'll report this as a bug/missing (very simple) feature to SolidWorks but nonetheless the parts do work just assembling takes more time. I can make all the "Available / default dimensions" manually and then making a track will be a breeze again that is my plan.
